answer: The system resists Sybil attacks with a sequential delay proof that each identity must complete alone over 72 hours. At the start an ember is placed under a jade disc, and its heat must expand the disc by 1 millimeter, measured at hour 72. The disc and its sealed key are carried on foot across an oasis, with entry and exit scans at least 4 hours apart, and no other identity can use the same disc, heat record, or crossing. A gap in the hourly temperature log voids the attempt, so 100 fakes need 100 discs and 7,200 separate identity-hours.
